name: Provo Library Ballroom
description: A historic library ballroom reception venue with banquet and theater layouts, provided furniture, free audiovisual equipment, kitchen support, a stage, and space for up to 320 banquet guests.
priceText: Ballroom rental $840–$2,300 by day and time

Accessibility options > Wheelchair acces.wording: Wheelchair ramp at the south entrance

Accessibility options > Elevator.wording: Walk down the hall to the elevator, and select 3rd floor.

Accessibility options > Accessible parki.wording: Two accessible parking stalls near the entrance

Audio/Visual > Microphone.wording: Includes speakers, microphones, a projector, and a screen.

Features > Outside catering allowed.wording: Third-party vendors with no extra fees

Other > Piano.wording: Baby Grand Piano (for use in Ballroom only)

items.label: Description
items.value: A historic library ballroom reception venue with banquet and theater layouts, provided furniture, free audiovisual equipment, kitchen support, a stage, and space for up to 320 banquet guests.

items.label: Price
items.value: Ballroom rental $840–$2,300 by day and time

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
9-hour block, Mon-Thu 9am-6pm — $840 ($200 deposit)
14-hour block, Mon-Thu 9am-11pm — $1,350 ($300 deposit)
14-hour block, Fri-Sat 9am-11pm — $2,000 ($300 deposit)
15-hour block, Mon-Sat 9am-12am — $2,300 ($500 deposit)
All blocks include library tables, chairs and stage set up and taken down, kitchen use, all A/V equipment and the Brimhall Room
Provo residents: 15% off rental

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
Security/cleaning deposit: $200 (9-hour block), $300 (14-hour blocks), $500 (15-hour block), due at booking
Rental fee due 30 days before the event
100% deposit and rental refund with written cancellation 90+ days ahead; deposit forfeited within 89 days
Deposit refund depends on room condition

items.label: Brimhall Room #302
items.value: Theater: 75 · Classroom: 45 · Dinner: 56 · Price: included with Ballroom · Note: reservable no more than 30 days ahead

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Library tables and chairs, set up and taken down
Stage and 8-inch portable risers
Decorative easels
Three chandeliers (room fixtures)
Brimhall Room

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value: Library sets up and takes down its tables and chairs; renter must leave the room clean (security/cleaning deposit refunded based on room condition)

items.label: Microphone
items.value: Includes speakers, microphones, a projector, and a screen.

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Speakers and sound system (aux input)
Microphones and stands
Projector and screen
Televisions
All A/V free of charge, first come, first served

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Free audiovisual equipment
Brimhall Room included
Baby grand piano (Ballroom only), free
Kitchen use

items.label: Piano
items.value: Baby Grand Piano (for use in Ballroom only)

items.label: Outside catering allowed
items.value: Third-party vendors with no extra fees

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Third-party or self-provided catering allowed, no extra fees or restrictions
No cooking on site (chafing fuel only; electric warmers with approval)

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Warming oven
2 refrigerators
Freezer
Ice machine
Sinks
No cooking

items.label: Alcohol
items.value: Alcohol prohibited on all library premises

items.label: Sparklers
items.value: No (open flame, cold sparks and all pyrotechnics prohibited)

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No cooking in the facility
Access only during scheduled hours; overtime fees up to the full deposit
No midday furniture switchovers
No open flame or lit candles; no glitter, colored powder, fog, smoke, fireworks, cold sparks or pyrotechnics
Decorations pre-approved; no tape or adhesives on walls
No alcohol; no smoking
Library grounds (lawns, parking) not available for events

items.label: Wheelchair accessible
items.value: Wheelchair ramp at the south entrance

items.label: Elevator
items.value: Walk down the hall to the elevator, and select 3rd floor.

items.label: Accessible parking
items.value: Two accessible parking stalls near the entrance

items.label: Accessibility
items.value:
Wheelchair-accessible ramp at the South Entrance
Elevator from the underground garage to the third-floor Ballroom
Accessible parking: 3 stalls in the South lot, 2 near the Academy Entrance in the underground garage

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Free for attendees of scheduled events
Two above-ground lots (north and south) and a one-level underground garage (enter off 100 East; 8 ft clearance)
Underground garage entrance nearest the Academy Ballroom

items.label: Notes
items.value:
User-provided decorations, linens and catering allowed with no extra fees
Ballroom cannot be booked online; book by phone or in person (Events Scheduling Office, Room #213)
Bookable up to one year ahead
Ballroom is room #315, third floor of the Academy wing
